reward: (energy_after-energy_before)/10 - 1 if death; delta term counted once
prior: six Laya probabilities are inputs to independent actor/critic networks; weights frozen; missing Laya in ablation = zero vector
sampling: own CPU torch generator state for each individual; final legal policy distribution sampled
evaluation: online A/B/A with no resurrection; separate frozen heldout worlds from recorded checkpoints; memory updates allowed identically
learning_gain_gate: matched heldout B mean total reward > initial frozen B by at least 0.1, no greater death count, positive reward difference in at least 2 of 3 seeds; exploratory small-sample signal only
laya_value_gate: same gate comparing B against no-Laya learner; report failures/negative differences
adaptation: mean reward per stage and per 20-step window; return-A first 20 vs initial-A first 20; dead suffix unobserved, never zero-filled as survival
limits: 360 steps is a feasibility budget, not a claim that PPO converges or persistent ecology succeeds
